mapper.select: SELECT f.id, f.product_id, p.product_name, p.main_image, p.base_price, p.sale_price as user_level_price, p.stock, p.sales_count, CASE WHEN p.status = 1 THEN '上架' ELSE '下架' END as status, f.create_time FROM product_favorite f LEFT JOIN product p ON f.product_id = p.id WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY f.create_time DESC
